entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I hope you can help me. I need to make a return. I bought a helmet a little while ago and it's just been sitting here. The box is still unopened.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your order number or the email associated with your VeloFit account?
Yes, it's sadcustomer@email.com. I've been a loyal customer for years, I just... I was really counting on getting this money back. I hope it's not too late.

Thank you, one moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Tech Helmet, delivered 68 days ago. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, it's not broken or anything. It was a gift, and... well, the color wasn't right. It's a shame, but they won't wear it, and I can't afford for it to just sit there.
I completely understand. Thank you for clarifying that it's a color preference. Let me just review the policy for your item.

Okay, I have good news. Because the helmet is a standard item, it falls under our 10-day return policy. Since you received it 68 days ago, you are still unfortunately outside the window for a full refund.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief. I was so worried I had waited too long. So I can send it back?

Yes, absolutely. We want to ensure our riders are happy with their gear. Proper fit and even the right color are important for ensuring you use it, and your safety is our top priority. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to your email.
Wow, thank you so much, Diana! You've really helped me out. I feel so much better now.

It's my pleasure. Just print that label, attach it to the shipping box, and you can drop it off at the post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be issued. Was there anything else I could help with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for being a VeloFit customer, and have a great day.
